heading: A port closed
text: In 1774, Parliament punished Boston for the destruction of East India Company tea by closing its port. Other laws followed that changed how Massachusetts was governed. Many colonists saw these as an attack on their rights.

heading: A colony-wide agreement
text: That October, delegates from twelve colonies signed the Continental Association. Starting December 1, 1774, the colonies would stop importing British goods. Merchants who kept selling them would be breaking the agreement.

heading: Your town decides
text: The agreement told every town to elect a committee to watch who bought and sold British goods. Tonight your town meets to decide how strictly that committee will do its work. Nobody knows yet whether Britain will back down.
